# Flutter MCP Suite Monorepo

> An interactive AI Agent Playground monorepo. It features a headless pure-Dart core package (`dart_mcp_core`), shared UI components (`flutter_ui_mcp_core`), an interactive Flutter UI widget package (`flutter_ui_mcp`), a dynamic Generative UI widget (`flutter_genui_mcp`), and an opt-in on-device GGUF engine (`flutter_ui_mcp_embedded`).

## Docs

- [Full Documentation for LLMs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lschaffer/flutter_mcp_suite/main/llms-full.txt): All documentation inlined in a single file for LLM consumption

## Core Packages

### 1. [`dart_mcp_core`](dart_mcp_core) (Headless Core - 1.4.0)
- [dart_mcp_core/lib/src/llm/llm_service.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/dart_mcp_core/lib/src/llm/llm_service.dart): LLM provider adapters (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, and embedded delegates).
- [dart_mcp_core/lib/src/llm/llm_response.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/dart_mcp_core/lib/src/llm/llm_response.dart): Common LLM request, response, and stream chunk schemas.
- [dart_mcp_core/lib/src/agents/agents_engine.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/dart_mcp_core/lib/src/agents/agents_engine.dart): Execution loop with tool calling, planning, episodic memory, and sub-agent delegation.
- [dart_mcp_core/lib/src/mcp/mcp_client.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/dart_mcp_core/lib/src/mcp/mcp_client.dart): HTTP/SSE and stdio subprocess client transport handlers.

### 2. [`flutter_ui_mcp_core`](flutter_ui_mcp_core) (Shared UI & Controller Layer - 1.4.0)
- [flutter_ui_mcp_core/lib/playground_controller.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/flutter_ui_mcp_core/lib/playground_controller.dart): State manager orchestrating agent runs, tool execution, and reactive state.
- [flutter_ui_mcp_core/lib/src/widgets/mcp_chat_input_bar.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/flutter_ui_mcp_core/lib/src/widgets/mcp_chat_input_bar.dart): Standalone prompt composer with attachment preview and clipboard paste.
- [flutter_ui_mcp_core/lib/src/services/embedded_llm/embedded_llm_driver.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/flutter_ui_mcp_core/lib/src/services/embedded_llm/embedded_llm_driver.dart): Pluggable driver contract and registry decoupling native FFI engines from UI.

### 3. [`flutter_ui_mcp`](flutter_ui_mcp) (Classic AI Agent & Chat UI - 1.4.0)
- [flutter_ui_mcp/lib/flutter_ui_mcp_widget.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/flutter_ui_mcp/lib/flutter_ui_mcp_widget.dart): `McpPlayground` with `topBarBuilder` and `settingsDialogBuilder`.
- [flutter_ui_mcp/lib/mcp_chat_view.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/flutter_ui_mcp/lib/mcp_chat_view.dart): Standalone headless chat stream view for custom parent apps and embedded layouts.

### 4. [`flutter_ui_mcp_embedded`](flutter_ui_mcp_embedded) (Opt-In Embedded GGUF Engine - 1.4.0)
- [flutter_ui_mcp_embedded/lib/flutter_ui_mcp_embedded.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/flutter_ui_mcp_embedded/lib/flutter_ui_mcp_embedded.dart): Provides `FlutterUiMcpEmbedded.register()` to bind `llamadart` (`llama.cpp` / WebGPU) into `EmbeddedLlmRegistry`.

### 5. [`flutter_genui_mcp`](flutter_genui_mcp) (Dynamic Generative UI - 1.4.0)
- Dynamic GenUI (`A2UI`) widget for structured interactive UI generation.

## Examples & Demos

- [examples/flutter/example_embedded/lib/main.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/examples/flutter/example_embedded/lib/main.dart): Flutter app configured for offline on-device GGUF execution with `flutter_ui_mcp_embedded`.
- [examples/dart/embedded_example/main.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/examples/dart/embedded_example/main.dart): Pure Dart console app executing `llamadart` GGUF model offline on CPU.
- [examples/dart/cli_example/main.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/examples/dart/cli_example/main.dart): CLI chat agent for multi-turn local Node/Python subprocess MCP server runs.
- [examples/dart/local_filesystem_example/main.dart](file:///c:/projects/ls/mcp_playground/examples/dart/local_filesystem_example/main.dart): Headless agent running `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` to inspect filesystem.
